title: Bright [C II] and Dust Emission in Three z > 6.6 Quasar Host Galaxies Observed by ALMA
question: What are the [C II] and FIR dust properties, kinematics and dynamical masses of three z>6.6 VIKING quasar hosts, and how do they relate to the quasars' black holes?

what.value: Mg II redshifts and black hole masses of VIKING quasars

evidence.loc: 4.2 Correlations Between UV and FIR Properties
evidence.quote: The black hole masses of the VIKING quasars, estimated from the width of the Mg II line and the strength of the quasar’s continuum, were derived in (cite: der14).

recipe.method: Standard CASA reduction, flagging, removal of long baselines to eliminate striping, cleaning with robust=0.5
Gaussian + constant fit to spectrum of brightest pixel in cube smoothed with 1 arcsec; line maps by averaging over FWHM; sizes with imfit

recipe.goal: Derive FIR/TIR luminosities, SFRs, dust masses
recipe.method: Scale modified black body (47 K, beta=1.6) and Arp 220/M82 templates to 158 um continuum; SFR from L_TIR (Murphy+11) and L_[CII] (De Looze+14); dust mass with kappa from Dunne+00
assumptions: Td=47 K, beta=1.6, tau<<1 at lambda>40 um; Kroupa IMF; emission powered by star formation

recipe.goal: Constrain dust temperature of J0305–3150 from continuum slope with CMB
recipe.method: Fit modified black body (beta=1.6 fixed) to continuum at ~234 and ~250 GHz, with and without CMB heating/contrast; Monte Carlo errors
Empirical tilted-ring models with single disk of constant scale height, compared with data in l-v diagrams
key_parameters: Rotation curve rising linearly to 150 km/s at 0.1 arcsec then flat

recipe.goal: Estimate dynamical masses and compare M_BH to M_dyn
recipe.method: M_dyn=1.16e5 v_circ^2 D with v_circ=0.75 FWHM/sin(i), i from axis ratio; compare with Kormendy & Ho relation
key_parameters: D=1.5x deconvolved size; i=25, 50 deg; 55 deg and 3±1 kpc for J2348–3054

answer_key.quantity: Continuum flux density at 158 um (J2348, J0109, J0305)
[C II] minus Mg II velocity shift J0109–3047

evidence.quote: In one quasar we derive a dust temperature of $30^{+12}_{-9}$ K from the continuum slope

answer_key.quantity: Mean Mg II blueshift in z>~6 quasars

evidence.quote: The mean and the median of this sample are –480 and –467 km s$^{-1}$, respectively, with a standard deviation of 630 km s$^{-1}$.
we calculate a dynamical mass of $(7.2\pm3.6)\times10^{10}$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}$, $(1.4\pm0.4)\times10^{11}$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}$, and $(4.1\pm0.5)\times10^{10}$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}$
We find a mean of 1.9% and a median of 1.3%, compared to the local value of $0.49^{+0.06}_{-0.05}$%.
